name: Regulgo
description: Regulgo was a planet located in the Regulgo system, a part of the Ryndellian sector within the Mid Rim and Trailing Sectors regions. Months after Han Solo departed Kamar in approximately 2 BBY, Kamarians tracked him down on Regulgo. While there, the Kamarians attacked Solo and took him captive; however, Solo eventually escaped.
